panel.label: 🏠 Home
panel.name: tab_home
panel.text_editor:
Welcome to the S24 Engine Guide 🚀
This guide provides quick reference for advanced settings, defaults, and tuning tips for experienced users.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📖 GUIDE SECTIONS
• Common Settings - Most frequently adjusted values and defaults • S24 Console - Command-line interface to the viewer • Troubleshooting - Common issues and solutions • KVTweaks Tabs - Detailed breakdown of each tab
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚡ QUICK START
• Most settings take effect IMMEDIATELY - no restart needed • Shader changes require: RESETS → Purge Shader Cache → Restart • Hover over controls in KVTweaks for detailed tooltips • Use RESETS tab to restore defaults or purge caches
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📂 KVTWEAKS TAB OVERVIEW
CPU & Memory → Core count, thread pool, RAM/VRAM allocation RAM Cache → KVRAM texture buffer: budget, thresholds, eviction timing Rendering Core → LOD factors, draw distance, avatar complexity/feathering Rendering Adv → SSAO, bump/glow, pool skip, D3D11 debug layer, shader cache SSR → Screen-space reflections (global, all surfaces) Water → Water appearance: metallic, roughness, color, presets Night Sky → Star style, glow, density, nebulas, shooting stars Sky → Extra 2.5D cirrus/cumulus cloud decks over the active preset Shadows → Shadow quality, bias, throttling, resolution Lighting → Ambient, sun/moon controls Textures → Discard level, max resolution, fetch concurrency, HUD limits Network → Bandwidth throttle, ACK timing, plugin threading/CPU limit Audio → Streaming engine, metadata, FMOD/OpenAL Experimental → Selection beam styling and custom colors Reflections → Reflection probes: intensity, saturation, blur Resets → Cache purging, settings reset, factory reset Movement → Smooth keyboard movement with acceleration curves
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 PRO TIP
Start with the Common Settings tab to see the most frequently adjusted values and their defaults. Then explore specific tabs for detailed controls.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES
• These are EXPERT controls - for experienced users • Changes can impact stability and performance • TPV Policy compliant - all settings reset to Linden Lab defaults • Reflections/Water enhancements are opt-in and default to standard values • Ground movement smoothing is disabled by default; flight smoothing is enabled by default

panel.label: ⚙️ Common Settings
panel.name: tab_common_settings
panel.text_editor:
Most frequently adjusted values and their defaults from settings.xml
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📊 CPU & THREADING (KVTweaks → CPU & Memory)
EmulateCoreCount Default: 0 (auto-detect) Range: 0-128 Notes: Override CPU core count detection. 0 = auto, 1-128 = manual override
KVdefault_cores Default: 6 Range: 1-128 Notes: Default cores allocated for texture decode operations
KVmin_cores Default: 2 Range: 1-128 Notes: Minimum cores for texture decode (prevents under-allocation)
KVmax_cores Default: 16 Range: 1-128 Notes: Maximum cores for texture decode (prevents over-allocation)
RenderProcessQoS ("CPU Process QoS" slider) Default: 1 (Normal) Range: 0-2 (0=Eco, 1=Normal, 2=High) Notes: Real Windows process/thread scheduling tier, applied at launch. Eco enables EcoQoS power throttling (background-friendly); High disables throttling and boosts main-thread/process priority for best frame timing.
RunMultipleThreads Default: true Notes: Keep background threads active during render
RenderCPUBasis (console/settings.xml only - not exposed as a KVTweaks slider) Default: 3000 MHz Notes: Reference CPU frequency the GPU benchmark biases its classification against, so a high-end GPU isn't over-classified on a weak CPU
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💾 MEMORY MANAGEMENT (KVTweaks → CPU & Memory)
MaxHeapSize64 Default: 16 GB Range: 8-64 GB Notes: Maximum heap size for viewer process
RenderMaxVRAMBudget Default: 0 (auto-detect) Range: 0-32768 MB Notes: Maximum VRAM budget. 0 = automatic detection and management
RenderVRAMSoftPressureFraction Default: 0.8 (80%) Range: 0.5-1.0 Notes: VRAM usage fraction at which the deterministic budget allocator starts lowering texture discard levels to stay under budget
RenderMinFreeMainMemoryThreshold Default: 512 MB Notes: Minimum free RAM threshold before viewer reduces memory usage.
NonvisibleObjectsInMemoryTime Default: 64 frames Range: 0-1024 (0=no limit) Notes: How many frames to keep non-visible objects in memory
MainWorkTime Default: 1.00 ms Range: 0.01-3.00 ms Notes: Main loop time budget per frame
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 RENDERING CORE (KVTweaks → Rendering Core)
RenderVolumeLODFactor Default: 4.125 Range: 0.0-8.0 Notes: Mesh detail multiplier. Higher = more detail, more GPU load
RenderAvatarLODFactor Default: 0.5 Range: 0.0-4.0 Notes: Avatar mesh detail multiplier
RenderTerrainLODFactor Default: 1.0 Range: 1.0-4.0 Notes: Terrain mesh resolution multiplier
RenderTreeLODFactor Default: 0.5 Range: 0.0-4.0 Notes: Legacy Linden tree detail
RenderFarClip Default: 256 meters Range: 64-1024 meters Notes: Draw distance. Higher = more objects rendered, more load
RenderAutoMuteSurfaceAreaLimit Default: 1000.0 m² Notes: Auto-mute avatars whose attachments exceed this surface area (0=off)
AvatarFeathering Default: 16.0 Range: 0.0-8.0 (KVTweaks slider - note the shipped default exceeds the slider's own max) Notes: Softens avatar LOD transitions - lower = softer
RenderCompressTextures Default: false (Experimental, opt-in) Notes: Real-time BC7 GPU texture compression (background, minimal frame-time impact)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖼️ TEXTURES (KVTweaks → Textures)
TextureDiscardLevel Default: 0 (full quality) Range: 0-5 Notes: Force lower-resolution textures. Higher = more VRAM saved, less detail
RenderMaxTextureResolution Default: 2048 px Range: 512-4096 px Notes: Maximum allowed texture resolution per dimension
TextureFetchConcurrency Default: 0 (auto - scales to 16) Range: 0-64 Notes: S24 raised the manual cap from 16→64 for modern connections
TextureNewByteRange Default: true Notes: HTTP byte-range requests for progressive texture loading
RenderHUDTexturesWarning / RenderHUDOversizedTexturesWarning / RenderHUDTexturesMemoryWarning Defaults: 200 textures / 6 oversized / ~30.5 MB (32,000,000 bytes) Notes: Warning thresholds only - HUD still renders past them, just logs a warning
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌊 WATER (KVTweaks → Water - S24 Exclusive System)
Water Preset System Location: KVTweaks → Water tab Features: Save/Load/Delete custom water shader profiles Notes: Complete S24 water control system with named presets
RenderWaterMetallic Default: 1.0 (fully metallic mirror) Range: 0.35-1.0 (below 0.35 causes whiteout) Notes: S24 runtime control - LL hardcodes this at 1.0, now fully adjustable
RenderWaterRoughnessOverride Default: 0.0 (use environment blur) Range: 0.0-0.60 (above 0.60 causes whiteout) Notes: 0.0 = LL behavior, 0.01+ = manual override for custom reflections
RenderWaterReflectionIntensity / RenderWaterSpecularIntensity Default: 1.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-3.0 / 0.0-5.0 Notes: Global reflection strength, and sun/moon specular sparkle intensity
RenderWaterColorTintR/G/B/A Default: 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.0 (neutral, no tint) Range: 0.0-2.0 (RGB), 0.0-1.0 (A = tint strength) Notes: A is the master strength - 0.0 disables the tint entirely regardless of RGB
RenderWaterFresnelPower Default: 2.0 Range: 0.5-4.0 Notes: LL hardcodes this at 2.0. Lower=soft linear edge, higher=sharp dramatic edge
RenderWaterWaveSpeed Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-3.0 (0.0 freezes animation) Notes: Wave animation playback speed
RenderWaterShoreFadeDistance Default: 60.0 m Range: 10.0-120.0 m Notes: LL hardcodes this at 60. Lower=softer beach, higher=sharper rocky coast
RenderWaterUnderwaterFogMult Default: 1.0 Range: 0.1-5.0 Notes: Underwater-only visibility multiplier, doesn't affect above-water fog
RenderWaterReflectionWarmth Default: 1.0 Range: 0.5-2.0 Notes: Artistic color grading - below 1.0 cools toward moonlight, above warms toward golden hour
RenderWaterColorAbsorptionRate Default: 0.15 (per meter) Range: 0.01-1.0 Notes: How fast the water tint ramps in with depth (Beer-Lambert style). Lower=clearer shallow water with a long gradient to full tint, higher=tint appears almost immediately at the shore
RenderWaterWindInfluence Default: 0.0 (off) Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Blends live simulator wind (the same system used for sailing - Develop>Wind Vectors to visualize it) into water wave direction and animation speed. 0.0=ignore wind, use only the EEP water preset's authored waves. 1.0=fully follow live wind
RenderWaterWindMagnitudeCap Default: 15.0 Range: 0.0-50.0 Notes: Ceiling on the live wind vector's own strength before it affects water - limits how much a storm/gust can push wave speed/direction regardless of how extreme the simulator's actual wind gets. Only matters when RenderWaterWindInfluence > 0. 0.0=always treat wind as calm
RenderUIHueShiftFloaters / Menus / Controls / Text / Inventory / Map / Script / Misc Default: 0.0 (degrees) each Range: -180.0 to 180.0 Notes: Rotates each UI color category's hue independently (KVTweaks "UI Hue" tab). Floaters=window chrome/panels, Menus=menu bar/pie menu/toolbar, Controls=buttons/sliders/scrollbars, Text=chat/nametags/notifications/tooltips, Inventory=inventory/filters/outfits, Map=minimap/beacons/pathfinding, Script=script editor/syntax highlighting, Misc=everything else (login screen included). 0=skin default; pure white/gray/black elements are unaffected since hue has no meaning at zero saturation
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌌 NIGHT SKY (KVTweaks → Night Sky - S24 Exclusive System)
RenderSkyStyle Default: 0 (Default) Options: 0=Default, 1=Real Constellations, 2=Starry Night (Van Gogh) Notes: Requires a viewer restart - star placement is baked once at startup
RenderStarGlow Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-3.0 Notes: 0-1 scales brightness; above 1.0 adds a soft colored haze halo instead of blowing out to white
RenderStarDensity Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Fraction of the star field shown - pure visibility cull, no performance cost
RenderStarDustIntensity / RenderNebulaIntensity Default: 1.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-2.0 Notes: Milky-Way-style dust band and soft colored nebula patch strength
RenderShootingStars / RenderShootingStarFrequency Default: true / 4.0 per minute Range (frequency): 0.0-20.0 Notes: 0=effectively off, 20=meteor shower
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
☁️ SKY / CLOUD LAYERS (KVTweaks → Sky - S24 2.5D Depth System)
RenderCloudLayers Default: true Notes: Extra cirrus/cumulus decks layered on top of the active WindLight preset's own clouds - complementary, not a replacement
RenderCloudLayerOpacity Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-2.0 Notes: Opacity multiplier for the extra decks
RenderCloudLayerHeightSkew Default: 0.3 Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Visual skew trick to make cirrus read higher / cumulus read lower than the base layer - not true altitude
RenderCloudCirrusScale / RenderCloudCumulusScale Default: 0.55 / 1.7 Notes: Cell-size ratios relative to the active preset's own cloud scale
RenderCloudCirrusScrollMult / RenderCloudCumulusScrollMult Default: 1.6 / 0.6 Notes: Wind-scroll speed multipliers relative to the base cloud layer's own rate
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 RAM CACHE (KVTweaks → RAM Cache)
KVRAMCacheEnabled Default: Disabled (false) Notes: Fast RAM buffer for GPU-evicted textures. Reduces disk I/O when textures are re-requested. Passive equilibrium system with user-controlled budget.
KVRAMCacheRAMBudgetMB Default: 2048 MB Range: 256-4096 MB (in 256 MB steps) Notes: RAM cache size for texture buffer. Higher values = more texture cache hits before disk fetch. Monitor system RAM usage when increasing.
KVRAMCacheSoftThreshold Default: 0.75 (75%) Range: 0.5-1.0 Notes: Begin gentle RAM-to-Disk eviction at this buffer usage level. Passive cleanup.
KVRAMCacheHardThreshold Default: 0.90 (90%) Range: 0.7-1.0 Notes: Aggressive RAM-to-Disk eviction at this usage (emergency mode). Prevents overflow.
KVRAMCacheRetentionTimeSec (renamed from KVRAMCacheGracePeriodSec) Default: 10.0 seconds Range: 0.1-30.0 seconds (0.1 second steps) Notes: Minimum retention time before a texture is eligible for eviction. Lower = more aggressive cleanup, higher = less churn.
KVRAMCacheMinDeckSize Default: 100 textures Range: 100-10000 textures (100 steps) Notes: Minimum texture deck size. Higher = more cache hits before rotation/eviction.
KVRAMCacheDebugLogging Default: Disabled (false) Notes: Enable verbose logging (evictions, queries, pressure). Use for diagnostics.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌑 SHADOWS (KVTweaks → Shadows)
RenderShadowResolutionScale Default: 3.0 Range: 0.25-4.0 Notes: S24 uses an advanced cascade system - higher than standard LL values
RenderShadowBias / RenderShadowOffset Default: -0.002 / 0.01 Range: -0.5 to 0.5 (both) Notes: Main directional-light shadow depth bias/offset - reduces acne (too low) or peter-panning (too high). Separate Spot Shadow and Tree Shadow bias/offset controls also exist further down the Shadows tab.
RenderShadowThrottleEnabled Default: true Notes: S24 dynamic cascade throttling - distant cascades update less often while the camera is still, for free performance with no visible quality loss
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ REFLECTIONS (KVTweaks → Reflections)
Enable Reflection Probes (RenderReflectionProbesEnabled) Default: true Notes: Master toggle, right here in the Reflections tab - requires a shader rebuild (RESETS → Purge Shader Cache → Restart) to take effect
Reflection Intensity / Saturation / Contrast Default: 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-10.0 / 0.0-5.0 / 0.0-5.0 Notes: RenderReflectionProbeIntensity/Saturation/Contrast - brightness, color, and punch of what the probes capture
Reflection Blur (RenderReflectionProbeBlurLODBias) Default: 0.0 Range: -10.0 to 10.0 Notes: Negative = sharper, positive = softer
Ambient Contribution (RenderReflectionProbeAmbientMultiplier) Default: 0.2 Range: 0.0-10.0 Notes: Kept low by design - local lights are additive on top of ambient, so a low floor here lets local light actually read instead of being washed out
Equalize Faces / Opacity (RenderReflectionProbeEqualize / RenderReflectionProbeOpacity) Default: 0.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-1.0 (both) Notes: Equalize blends toward a fully-averaged reflection across all 6 probe faces (0=full detail, 1=fully equalized); Opacity is probe visibility (0=transparent)
⚠ If any of these tweaks appear to do nothing: RESETS → Purge Shader Cache → Restart.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎮 MOVEMENT (KVTweaks → Movement)
SmoothKeyboardMovement (ground walking/running) Default: Disabled (false) Notes: S24 feature - off by default, purely aesthetic enhancement
SmoothMovementAccelTime / SmoothMovementDecelTime Default: 0.20s / 0.15s Range: 0.05-1.0s (both) Notes: Time to reach full speed / time to stop, for ground movement
SmoothFlightMovement (flying) Default: Enabled (true) Notes: Separate system from ground smoothing - on by default, unlike it
SmoothFlightAccelTime / SmoothFlightDecelTime Default: 0.35s / 0.40s Range: 0.05-1.0s (both) Notes: Time to reach full speed / time to stop, for flight
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌐 NETWORK (KVTweaks → Network)
ThrottleBandwidthKBPS Default: 3000 kbps Range: 500-50000 kbps Notes: S24 raised the cap from 10 Mbps to 50 Mbps for modern connections. Recommend 20000-40000 for fast fiber
AckCollectTime Default: 0.1 sec Range: 0.001-1.0 sec Notes: Time to batch ACK messages before sending - affects network efficiency
PluginUseReadThread Default: false Notes: Offload plugin (media/CEF) I/O to a dedicated thread
PluginInstancesCPULimit Default: 0.90 (90%) Range: 0.0-0.99 (0=disabled) Notes: Maximum CPU usage allowed for plugin processes combined
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔬 SELECTION BEAM (KVTweaks → Experimental)
SelectionBeamStyle Default: 2 (Hybrid - Line + Glow, "Lightsaber") Options: 0=Particles Only (Classic), 1=Solid Line Only, 2=Hybrid Line+Glow
SelectionBeamLineStyle Default: 0 (Solid) Options: 0=Solid, 1=Dotted, 2=Dashed, 3=Dash-Dot
SelectionBeamWidth Default: 2.0 pixels Range: 0.5-6.0 Notes: Real DX11 billboard geometry - D3D11 has no glLineWidth() equivalent
SelectionBeamParticleScale Default: 1.5 Range: 0.5-3.0 Notes: Glow particle size for the Hybrid style
Beam Color Location: Preferences → Colors → My Effects Notes: Not a KVTweaks control - separate color picker panel
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 PRO TIP
These settings are from the actual KVTweaks tabs and settings.xml. Many are dynamically managed by the viewer (VRAM, texture memory, thread counts). Start with defaults and adjust incrementally while monitoring FPS and system resources.

panel.label: 💻 S24 Console
panel.name: tab_console
panel.text_editor:
Command-line interface to the viewer. Access with Ctrl+Shift+4
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔍 OBJECT & AVATAR COMMANDS
find <name|uuid> Select and beacon a specific avatar (or object, by UUID) - great for locating something transparent or hard to see Example: find john
find clear Remove the active beacon (also: find off)
top [mode] [options] Top objects by cost/physics/streaming/triangles/scripts (UNIX-style tool) Modes: cost/render, physics/phys, streaming, triangles/tris, script/scripts Scope: -p/--parcel, -r/--region Ownership: -s/--self, -g/--group, -o/--owner UUID Display: -n/--limit N (default 10, max 50) Example: top scripts -p -s Full syntax: top --help
lookat <name|uuid> Point camera at avatar or object (partial name matching) Example: lookat john
scan [range] Show all avatars in sim with distance and UUID (optional range in meters, default unlimited) Example: scan 50
whois <name|uuid> Show detailed avatar information (UUID, display name, profile) Example: whois john
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ SETTINGS MANAGEMENT
get <setting> Read current value of a debug setting Supports wildcard: get *texture* Example: get RenderFarClip
set <setting> <value> Change a debug setting value (auto-detects BOOL/S32/U32/F32/STRING) Example: set RenderFarClip 256
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌐 WEB & INFORMATION
motd Display Message of the Day with URL
web <url> Open URL in preferred browser (internal/external) Example: web https://secondlife.com
ver Show S24 version and build information
time Display current SL time and local time
uptime Show viewer session uptime
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🪟 FLOATER MANAGEMENT
open list Show all registered floater names in the viewer
open <name> Open a specific floater window Example: open preferences
open close <name> Close a specific floater window Example: open close inventory
open toggle <name> Toggle a floater's visibility Example: open toggle preferences
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✈️ MOVEMENT & POSITIONING
tp <home|back|cam|name|uuid> Teleport to home, your previous location, your camera position, or a named/UUID avatar - use lookat/scan first to identify a target Example: tp home
fly Toggle flight mode on/off
fly <altitude> Fly to absolute altitude (smooth autopilot movement) Example: fly 1000
fly <altitude> --fast Fly to altitude with turbo boost Example: fly 1000 --fast
fly down Descend to ground level (0.5m hover)
fly down --fast Fast descent to ground
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💬 CHAT & COMMUNICATION
say <message> Send message to local chat Example: say Hello World
shout <message> Send message with extended range (shout) Example: shout Can anyone hear me?
echo <text> Echo text back to console (testing/debugging) Example: echo test message
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠️ UTILITY COMMANDS
calc <expression> Evaluate mathematical expression Example: calc 2 + 2 * 3
uuid <uuid> Identify what a UUID represents (avatar, object, texture, inventory, group, or your own agent/session ID) Example: uuid 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
clear (alias: cls) Clear the console output buffer
quit (alias: exit) Close the S24 Console window
shutdown now Quit the viewer immediately (clean shutdown - skips the confirmation dialog, logout/metrics still run normally)
shutdown <seconds> Quit the viewer after a countdown Example: shutdown 300 (exit in 5 minutes)
shutdown cancel Abort a scheduled shutdown timer (aliases: abort, stop)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📖 HELP SYSTEM
list Display the full command list with syntax (this reference, in-console)
help <command> Show quick help for specific command Example: help top
<command> --help Show detailed documentation with examples (where available, e.g. top) Example: top --help
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 TIPS & BEST PRACTICES
• Commands are case-insensitive: GET, get, Get all work • Use ↑/↓ arrow keys to recall command history • Partial name matching: lookat foo finds "Foo Resident" • Unlimited range: scan and find work beyond draw distance • Beacon persistence: Beacons track moving avatars automatically • Wildcard search: Use * in get commands to find related settings
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔒 PRIVACY & SAFETY
• Help examples use privacy-safe placeholders (not real UUIDs) • TPV Policy compliant - respects LL's viewer boundaries • No remote execution - all commands are local to your viewer • No automated scanning - all actions require explicit commands

panel.label: 🔧 Troubleshooting
panel.name: tab_troubleshooting
panel.text_editor:
Common issues and solutions
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖥️ LOW FPS / STUTTERING
Symptom: Viewer runs slowly or has periodic frame drops
Solutions: • Reduce RenderFarClip (draw distance) to 64-128m • Lower RenderVolumeLODFactor to 1.5 or 1.0 • Disable Advanced Lighting in Preferences if GPU-limited • Check shadow resolution scale - lower if needed • Use Performance Test Mode to isolate GPU vs CPU bottlenecks • Monitor texture memory - reduce if exceeding VRAM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 WATER LOOKS WRONG
Symptom: Water appears too bright, too dark, or wrong color
Solutions: • Verify environment has proper water settings loaded • Disable Custom Tint if enabled in Water tab • Check Reflections: Reflection Probes must be enabled (Preferences → Graphics → Advanced) • Purge Shaders: Water shader changes may require cache purge + restart • Reset Water Metallic to 1.0 and Roughness Override to 0.0
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌑 SHADOW ACNE / LIGHT LEAKS
Symptom: Surfaces show speckled patterns or light bleeding through
Solutions: • Adjust Shadow Bias settings in Shadows tab • Check Resolution Scale - LL default is 3.0 • Increase Normal Offset slightly if acne persists • Try different shadow quality presets • Update GPU drivers - shadow artifacts often driver-related
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌳 MISSING TREES / GRASS
Symptom: Legacy Linden trees and grass not visible
Solutions: • Check render types: Advanced → Rendering → Types • Verify TREE and GRASS render types are enabled • Disable Performance Test Mode if active • Ensure pool skip isn't hiding vegetation (should be protected) • Region must support legacy vegetation objects
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🏃 SMOOTH MOVEMENT FEELS WRONG
Symptom: Movement feels sluggish or unresponsive after enabling
Solutions: • Reduce Acceleration Time from 0.2 to 0.1 seconds • Reduce Deceleration Time from 0.15 to 0.05 seconds • Disable feature if unnecessary - purely aesthetic • Feature is in Movement tab of KVTweaks
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💾 SETTINGS DON'T PERSIST
Symptom: KVTweaks settings reset after viewer restart
Solutions: • Ensure settings.xml is not read-only • Exit viewer properly (use Quit, not force-close) • Check file permissions in AppData folder • Most settings save immediately when changed
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💥 CRASHES AFTER CHANGES
Symptom: Viewer crashes or becomes unstable
Recovery Steps: 1. Start viewer with -noprobe flag (disables reflection probes) 2. Open KVTweaks → RESETS tab 3. Click Factory Reset 4. Click Purge All Caches 5. Restart normally 6. Re-enable settings gradually to isolate problem
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
☢️ NUCLEAR OPTION: COMPLETE RESET
When all else fails - return to absolute default state:
1. RESETS → Factory Reset (restores KVTweaks defaults) 2. RESETS → Purge All Caches (clears shader, texture, etc.) 3. Preferences → Graphics → Reset to Defaults 4. Restart viewer 5. Verify standard LL settings work before re-tweaking
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📝 STILL HAVING ISSUES?
Document before seeking help: • Screenshot each KVTweaks tab showing your settings • Note GPU model, RAM, driver version • Try updating GPU drivers first (most common fix) • Check viewer log for errors (Help → Report Bug → View Log)
Most rendering issues are GPU driver related!
